title: Engineers describe XF-131 Super Sentinel to Bill McDonald

tellings.quote: In 1992, McDonald met with two Northrup and two Loheed engineers who were fed up with the secrecy and classification of their work who kind of dictated the a drawing of a triangular ARV called the XF-131 Super Sentinel

plain: In 1992, two engineers from Northrop and two from Lockheed, fed up with the secrecy around their work, met a man named Bill McDonald and described a triangular craft to him, and he drew it as they talked. The craft was called the XF-131 Super Sentinel, an 'ARV', meaning a human-built craft said to copy alien technology, and the story is set in California's Mojave Desert. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this as McDonald's account, which would mean American aerospace firms had built such machines.
